summary: Those of the priests and their families who may eat of the holy things are described—Sacrificial animals are to be perfect and without blemish.
meta_description: Those of the priests and their families who may eat of the holy things are described—Sacrificial animals are to be perfect and without blemish.

footnotes.note2_c: HEB which they sanctify for me. Deut. 15:19.
footnotes.note3_a: HEB and any impurity is upon him.
footnotes.note5_a: HEB by whom he may become unclean.
footnotes.note10_a: HEB Any alien shall not eat a sacred thing.
footnotes.note11_a: IE if he purchase a servant, the servant may partake of the sacred food.
footnotes.note16_a: HEB And cause them to bear the iniquity of guilt in their eating of their holy things.
footnotes.note21_b: IE it must be whole, or without blemish, to be acceptable.
